edges.reason: Constructor assigns gov = msg.sender during initialization, granting initial governance rights to the deployer.
msg.sender is written into the gov state variable, so the caller identity determines who controls governance.
require(msg.sender == gov) gates the sensitive implementation-update path.
Constructor delegatecalls initialize(...) on the supplied implementation through delegateTo.
Constructor invokes _setImplementation to record the first implementation.
Gov-gated setter overwrites the implementation state variable used by every delegatecall.
_setImplementation delegatecalls _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation through delegateToImplementation.
mint ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
transfer ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
transferFrom ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
approve ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
increaseAllowance ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
rebase ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
decreaseAllowance ignores its arguments and forwards execution to the implementation.
_setPendingGov forwards execution to the implementation.
_setRebaser forwards execution to the implementation.
_setIncentivizer forwards execution to the implementation.
_acceptGov forwards execution to the implementation.
delegateBySig forwards execution to the implementation.
delegate forwards execution to the implementation.
Fallback rejects value then delegates every unmatched call to the implementation.
maxScalingFactor forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
allowance forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
delegates forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
balanceOf forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
balanceOfUnderlying forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
getPriorVotes forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
getCurrentVotes forwards the view call through delegateToViewAndReturn.
delegateAndReturn executes implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in its body.
delegateAndReturn uses inline assembly to copy returndata and to revert/return directly.
The delegatecall target read by delegateAndReturn is the implementation state variable.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data) in its body.
delegateTo uses inline assembly to revert with raw returndata when the delegatecall fails.
delegateToImplementation forwards the payload to delegateTo with the implementation address.
delegateToImplementation reads the implementation state variable as the delegatecall target.
delegateToViewImplementation performs address(this).staticcall to delegateToImplementation.
delegateToViewAndReturn performs address(this).staticcall using raw msg.data.
Constructor parameter implementation_ is used as the delegatecall target in the initialize step.
_setImplementation parameter is written into the implementation state variable, redirecting all delegatecalls.
becomeImplementationData is forwarded as the _becomeImplementation delegatecall payload.
Constructor becomeImplementationData argument is passed into _setImplementation.
callee parameter is the target of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
data parameter is the payload of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
delegateToImplementation data parameter is forwarded to delegateTo.
delegateToViewImplementation data parameter is encoded into the staticcall payload.
oldImplementation caches the implementation address before it is overwritten.
The delegatecall success flag is consumed by inline assembly to decide whether to revert.
returnData from the delegatecall is consumed by the inline assembly revert.
allowResign controls whether the _resignImplementation delegatecall is executed.
delegatecall executes the implementation's arbitrary code inside the delegator, which can re-enter the payable fallback and re-dispatch through delegateAndReturn.
delegateTo delegatecalls an externally supplied callee whose code can re-enter the delegator's fallback.
